update_from: https://cursor.com/docs/cli/reference/parameters (flags) -- Cursor publishes no per-model CLI price table this file could mirror; nothing below is a rate

plan.note: Cursor CLI under a Cursor account draws down the account's plan allowance; the CLI documents no usage or cost output and publishes no token-to-allowance conversion, so every Cursor dispatch is unpriced: billed_usd stays null and no proxy dollar is invented.

api_key.note: CURSOR_API_KEY / --api-key authentication is documented; its pricing is not recorded here and is never estimated from another harness's rates.

model_ids_note: No model ids are recorded. The host's own list is read at run time, read-only, with `agent models` / `--list-models` (bin/cursor_adapter.py models), and is never written into this file from memory. A `--model` given to the driver is passed to the CLI as written and resolved by Cursor, not by this file. The observed model is taken only from a `model` field the CLI's own JSON output carries.
